title: Introduction to Machine Learning
author: Ethem Alpaydin
subject: Machine Learning
description: Covers supervised and unsupervised learning, decision trees, neural networks, model evaluation, and practical machine learning concepts. Suitable for undergraduate-level ML courses.

title: Deep Learning
author: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
subject: Deep Learning
description: Comprehensive reference on deep neural networks, backpropagation, convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, optimization, and generative models. Graduate-level depth.

title: Database System Concepts
author: Abraham Silberschatz, Henry F. Korth, S. Sudarshan
subject: Database Systems
description: Standard textbook covering relational databases, SQL, normalization, transactions, indexing, query processing, database design, and transaction management.

title: Operating System Concepts
author: Abraham Silberschatz, Peter Baer Galvin, Greg Gagne
subject: Operating Systems
description: Covers process management, CPU scheduling, threads, synchronization, memory management, virtual memory, file systems, and concurrency.

title: Speech and Language Processing
author: Daniel Jurafsky, James H. Martin
subject: Natural Language Processing
description: Foundational NLP text covering tokenization, parsing, language models, information extraction, machine translation, and modern transformer-based approaches.

title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
author: Stuart Russell, Peter Norvig
subject: Artificial Intelligence
description: Comprehensive AI textbook covering intelligent agents, search algorithms, game playing, logic, planning, uncertainty, probabilistic reasoning, machine learning, and modern AI systems.

title: Computer Networks
author: Andrew S. Tanenbaum, David J. Wetherall
subject: Computer Networks
description: Covers layered network architecture, TCP/IP, Ethernet, routing protocols, transport protocols, wireless networks, network applications, and security fundamentals.

title: Financial Technology and the Future of Finance
author: Pranay Gupta
subject: Fintech
description: Overview of digital lending, payments infrastructure, financial technology platforms, and regulatory frameworks in the Indian fintech ecosystem.

title: Introduction to Algorithms
author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, Clifford Stein
subject: Data Structures and Algorithms
description: Comprehensive algorithms reference covering sorting, searching, graphs, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, data structures, and algorithm analysis.

title: Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications
author: Richard Szeliski
subject: Computer Vision
description: Covers image processing, feature detection, image matching, stereo vision, object recognition, 3D reconstruction, and modern computer vision applications.

title: Python Crash Course
author: Eric Matthes
subject: Python Programming
description: Practical introduction to Python programming covering variables, functions, classes, files, testing, data structures, and project-based programming.

title: Data Science from Scratch
author: Joel Grus
subject: Data Science
description: Introduces data science concepts from first principles, including Python, statistics, probability, data visualization, machine learning, and practical data analysis.

title: Hands-On Data Analysis with Pandas
author: Stefanie Molin
subject: Data Analysis
description: Practical guide to data analysis using Python and pandas, covering data cleaning, manipulation, visualization, exploratory analysis, and working with real datasets.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
subject: Software Engineering
description: Practical principles for writing readable, maintainable, testable software with emphasis on clean functions, classes, naming, refactoring, and software craftsmanship.

title: Computer Organization and Design
author: David A. Patterson, John L. Hennessy
subject: Computer Architecture
description: Introduces computer organization, processor design, instruction sets, memory hierarchy, performance, pipelining, and hardware-software interaction.

title: Computer Security: Principles and Practice
author: William Stallings, Lawrie Brown
subject: Cybersecurity
description: Covers security principles, cryptography, authentication, network security, malware, access control, secure software, and practical cybersecurity concepts.

title: Cloud Computing: Concepts, Technology and Architecture
author: Thomas Erl, Zaigham Mahmood, Ricardo Puttini
subject: Cloud Computing
description: Explains cloud computing fundamentals, virtualization, cloud services, infrastructure, deployment models, architecture, and distributed computing concepts.

title: Software Engineering
author: Ian Sommerville
subject: Software Engineering
description: Covers software development processes, requirements engineering, architecture, design, testing, project management, agile development, and software evolution.

title: Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning
author: Christopher M. Bishop
subject: Machine Learning
description: Advanced treatment of probabilistic machine learning covering classification, regression, graphical models, neural networks, kernels, and approximate inference.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
subject: Data Systems
description: Explores reliable, scalable, and maintainable data systems including databases, distributed systems, replication, partitioning, batch processing, stream processing, and system design.
